title: Insurance Claim Services Protocol Supplement — Air Treatment by Mold Remediation Tier
content:
**Rule.** For an Insurance Claim Services protocol supplement, the air treatment is priced as follows: on a tier that requires both containment and negative air, the tier's containment setup fee plus one air scrubber and one dehumidifier at the tier's daily rates for each day the job's containment was held, that is the calendar days from the job's containment date up to its clearance request date (the containment date counted, the request date not), held to the billable equipment day cap, because both machines run inside the held containment; on a tier that requires negative air but no containment, one air scrubber at that rate for each calendar day from the job's scheduled start date up to its clearance request date, held to the cap, because the scrubber runs only while the work runs; when either date is not recorded the cap is used; on any other tier, one dehumidifier for the tier's billable equipment day cap at the tier's dehumidifier daily rate.

Dates and tier are those of the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance; the rates, fee and cap are that tier's.

## Tier requirements and caps

| Mold Remediation tier | Containment required | Negative air required | Billable equipment day cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spot Mold Remediation | no | no | 2 |
| Limited Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 3 |
| Standard Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 4 |
| Extensive Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 6 |
| Attic and Crawlspace Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 4 |
| HVAC System Mold Remediation | no | yes | 3 |

## Day counts (hypothetical)

- Containment date 3 October, clearance requested 8 October: 5 days held (3 to 7 October). On Standard Mold Remediation (cap 4) the count is held to 4.
- Scheduled start 3 October, clearance requested 5 October on HVAC System Mold Remediation: 2 days (cap 3).
- No clearance request date recorded: the cap is used.
- Spot Mold Remediation (neither containment nor negative air), hypothetical dehumidifier rate 70.00: one dehumidifier for the 2-day cap, 140.00.
- Spot Mold Remediation (neither containment nor negative air), hypothetical dehumidifier rate 70.00: one dehumidifier for the 2-day cap, 140.00.

*Worked (hypothetical rates):* Limited Mold Remediation, containment fee 375.00, air scrubber 90.00 and dehumidifier 70.00 a day, 2 days held: 375.00 plus 160.00 multiplied by 2, or 695.00.
